Dear {vendor} team,

Thank you for your notice that the {plan} plan under {agreement} will change from {old_price} to {new_price}, with the increase taking effect on {effective_date}. The notice describes an increase of {increase_pct}, which is {monthly_increase} per month or {annual_impact} per year.

We would like to keep our current rate of {old_price} on {agreement}. Before the new price takes effect, please let us know whether you can maintain our existing rate or offer any other pricing options for the {plan} plan. We would appreciate a response by {deadline} so we can decide how to proceed.

Please reply to this email with your options, or call us to discuss them.

Best regards,

{sender}
